title: progressive-tenant-fallback-hedging-with-liveness-probe-integration
author: Maya Chen
body: Summary: Adds a progressive, per-tenant fallback hedging layer that cooperates with existing SLO enforcement and circuit state. This change integrates a lightweight liveness probe into regional proxies so hedging decisions can defer to recent probe results when deciding whether to trigger an aggressive fallback for a tenant. Motivation: During recent incidents (see ENG-8372) we observed tenants entering cascade fallbacks when regional KPIs briefly spiked; hedging too eagerly made recovery slower. This PR implements three coordinated behaviors: 1) a tenant-scoped fallback budget that ramps fallback aggressiveness based on short-window SLO burn and long-window sustained pressure; 2) hedged-request coordination that avoids duplicating load on the same region by consulting a fast in-process probe cache; 3) liveness-probe integration so that a region marked as recovering (probe success within 10s) will be given a controlled re-admission window rather than being blackholed immediately. The aim is to reduce false-positive quarantines and speed up recovery while preserving SLO guarantees.
changes_summary: Introduce tenant_fallback_budget store with TTL and epochal decay
Expose /internal/probe-status endpoint on regional proxy and short-lived cache in router
Add hedging coordinator that gates duplicate hedges and consults probe cache
SLO enforcer hook to adjust tenant budgets based on 1m/5m/1h burn windows
Unit and integration tests for hedging logic and probe cache interactions
Docs: operational runbook and Console dashboard feature flags
commits: a3d9b12: initial tenant budget prototype and tests
b7f41c0: proxy probe endpoint and in-memory cache implementation
c2e6d8f: hedging coordinator and router integration
d5f8a21: SLO enforcer hooks and config knobs
e1f3b44: add e2e tests, docs and rollout gating flag
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can the probe cache be sharded? Concern about thundering herd on warmup. Suggested metrics for probe cache hit/miss.
Maya Chen: Sharded by region+slot in next patch — implemented as lightweight modulo sharding. Added probe_cache_hit probe metric.
Sofia Reyes: Please make the default tenant fallback budget conservative and gated behind console feature flag for 2 weeks.
Maya Chen: Added console gating flag, default off for GA; enabled by canary rollout config in deployment manifests.
Arjun Patel: Integration tests look solid; one minor nit on context timeouts in router hedging path (fixed).
ci_checks: bench: warn (microbench shows ~2% router latency increase under synthetic load)
testing_notes: Local unit tests + CI integration harness exercised hedging under synthetic SLO burn patterns. Bench results show a small tail increase for median router latency when hedging is enabled; hedging coordinator avoids duplicate hedges to keep p95 impact <3%. E2E used staging canary with 5% traffic to validate no tenant regressions.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged in Console. Canary rollout: 5% tenants -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback if regional SLOs degrade beyond configured thresholds. Observability: add dashboard widgets for tenant_budget usage, probe_cache hit-rate, hedging-suppressed-count.
release_notes: Add tenant-scoped, progressive fallback hedging with probe-based re-admission heuristics. Feature-gated; no behavior change unless enabled. Improves recovery speed and reduces unnecessary tenant quarantines under short transient spikes.
related_issues: ENG-8372: tenant fallback storms during regional transient spikes
ENG-8410: stale circuit state prevents fast re-admission
merge_notes: Squash-merged after CI green and reviewers approved. Kept unhashed commits in changelog. Ensure staging rollout gate enabled before cherry-picking to release branches.
backports: will open follow-up PRs for release/2026-02 if any regressions observed
post_merge_actions: Enable feature for canary cohort via Console and run 48h smoke checks; alert paging on >1% tenant SLO breach in any region.
